headline: DeepSeek's flash model hits all-time high at 16.1% share
summary: DeepSeek's v4-flash-20260731 just set an all-time token-share record at 16.1%, vaulting to rank 1 and picking up 1.3 percentage points in a single day. The move reshuffled the top tier: Tencent dropped to rank 2, while OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna climbed 32 spots over 30 days to land at rank 3. Google's gemini-3.6-flash made a surprise 16-rank jump in one day to crack the top 15.
highlights: DeepSeek now commands 27.0% of all provider share, up 0.4 points today and 13.6 points in a week
OpenAI's trio of gpt-5.6 variants (luna, luna-pro, terra) all gained ground; luna-pro jumped 5 ranks in 24 hours
Google surged 1.1 percentage points today across its portfolio, with gemini-3.6-flash leading the charge
Two new entrants: OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small (rank 49) and NVIDIA's nemotron-3.5-lightning (rank 50)
Dropouts: Google's gemini-3.5-flash-20260519 and Qwen's qwen3.6-35b-a3b both fell out of the top 50
Market concentration (HHI) rose 2.3 points over 30 days, signaling tighter clustering around top players
